name: Past Kuuya
source:
Kuuya's previous incarnation, who made a contract with Futaba's previous incarnation.
[spoiler]He was originally a human priest who preached that death was not to be feared, but when he was dying, he became frightened and begged to become an ayakashi. He got his wish, becoming a tengu, and this meant his next incarnation (Kuuya) would be an ayakashi as well.[/spoiler]
